decisions.reason: A cleaning soap is a low-cost accessory that complements the core flooring business, and its value is still uncertain after one year, so the option is cheap to hold.
The maintenance oil line builds directly on existing surface-treatment know-how and carries little cost, so keeping the option open while demand resolves is sensible.
The care line for oiled floors supports sales of oiled parquet at low carrying cost, and there is no evidence yet that its value will not be realized.
A moisture-protection underlay is a cheap accessory that fits installer and retailer channels, and its prospects are not yet resolved, so it stays.
The high-density foam underlay may overlap with other underlays in the range, but its carrying cost is low and the uncertainty has not resolved, so keeping it is justified for now.
The oak parquet line is at the heart of the firm's established offer and is still being visibly marketed, so dropping it after only one year is unlikely.
